title: 第15章 你是神仙吗第16章 祸斗
content_zh:
放弃？
不！
下一刻，一股被屡次挫败而激起的戾气，猛然自陈知白胸膛炸开！
再退一步，便是前功尽弃！
今夜或许再无机会。
“滚！！！”
陈知白怒吼，眉心浮现出一枚逆鳞，透着诡异妖气。
与此同时，身后尚未闭合的灵界裂隙，恍如连通了九幽犬窟。
一头头眼泛绿光的猎犬疯狂涌出，毫不畏惧地朝着那那蛇妖扑咬而去，仿佛无穷无尽。
那蛇妖竖瞳中闪过一丝人性化的惊疑！
它看了看近在咫尺的帝流浆，又看了看状若疯魔的陈知白，以及那群不知死活的恶犬，在一个迟疑间，猛地一甩尾巴，掉头钻入密林深处，消失得无影无踪。
陈知白见状，不敢大意，一边踉跄冲去，一边指挥着群犬，环伺周围。
许是蛇妖清场的缘故。
这一次，再无野兽争抢。
那道凝实的金色光丝，笔直落下，不偏不倚，正落在他仰起的眉心上。
“嗡——！”
仿佛仙人抚顶，又似混沌初开的第一缕光。
一股无法言喻的玄妙感觉，自灵魂最深处轰然迸发，如种子破土，挣开血脉深处的门扉。
金线落尽。
充斥陈知白视野的金芒，也随之敛去，熟悉的世界再次回来。

但他的身体，已然不再熟悉。
一道古老而强大的力量，自血脉根源处涌出，迅速弥漫全身。
躯壳乃至灵魂，都在发生着微妙变化。
陈知白能清晰感觉到，一种全新力量在体内萌芽，这种感觉十分玄妙，但也极为恐怖。
欲戴王冠，必承其重。
掌握这道力量的同时，他的法力也在迅速消耗，直到这股力量完全觉醒，法力消耗的速度才稍微慢一些。
这一刻，一股明悟在陈知白心中滋生。
血脉神通，乃先祖之馈赠。
人族活跃数万载，不知出现过多少惊才绝艳之天才，每一名天才的出现，都会在不知不觉间在后裔血脉中刻下他的力量印记。
然而这些印记所代表的力量太强大了。
凡人的体魄，根本无法承载，故而只能冰封。
当机缘至，便会觉醒，此谓血脉神通。
人族如此，飞禽走兽亦如此。
“终于成了！”
陈知白长长吐了一口气。
content_en:
give up?
No!
The next moment, a rage aroused by repeated setbacks suddenly exploded from Chen Zhibai's chest!
If you take another step back, all your previous efforts will be wasted!
There may be no chance tonight.
"Go away!!!"
Chen Zhibai roared angrily, and a reverse scale appeared between his eyebrows, exuding a strange evil aura.
At the same time, the rift in the spiritual world behind him that had not yet been closed seemed to be connected to the Nine Nether Dog Cave.
A hound with green eyes rushed out crazily and attacked the snake demon without fear, seemingly endlessly.
A hint of human surprise flashed in the snake demon's vertical pupils!
It looked at Di Liujian who was very close at hand, then at the crazy-looking Chen Zhibai, and the group of vicious dogs that didn't know whether to live or die. After a moment of hesitation, it flicked its tail, turned around and dived into the depths of the dense forest, disappearing without a trace.
When Chen Zhibai saw this, he didn't dare to be careless. He stumbled and rushed forward, commanding the dogs to look around.
Maybe it's because the snake demon cleared the place.
This time, there were no wild beasts fighting for it.
The solid golden light fell straight down, impartially, and landed on his raised eyebrows.
“Buzz——!”
It's like an immortal caressing the top of the head, or like the first ray of light emerging from chaos.
An indescribable mysterious feeling burst out from the deepest part of the soul, like a seed breaking through the soil, opening the door deep in the bloodline.
The golden thread is gone.
The golden light that filled Chen Zhibai's vision also disappeared, and the familiar world returned again.
But his body is no longer familiar.
An ancient and powerful force surged out from the source of his blood and quickly filled his body.
The body and even the soul are undergoing subtle changes.
Chen Zhibai could clearly feel that a new kind of power was sprouting in his body. This feeling was very mysterious, but also extremely terrifying.
If you want to wear a crown, you must bear its weight.
While mastering this power, his mana was also consumed rapidly. Until this power was fully awakened, the rate of mana consumption was slightly slower.
At this moment, a sense of enlightenment grew in Chen Zhibai's heart.
Bloodline magical powers are gifts from ancestors.
The human race has been active for tens of thousands of years, and there have been countless amazing geniuses. The appearance of each genius will unknowingly leave the mark of his power in the blood of his descendants.
However, the power represented by these marks is too powerful.
A mortal's body cannot bear it at all, so it can only be frozen.
When the opportunity comes, you will awaken. This is called the magical power of blood.
This is true for humans, and it is also true for birds and beasts.
"It's finally done!"
Chen Zhibai let out a long breath.
